images.title: Anil's share of cake
images.purpose: Set up the question: 2 cakes, each cut into 5 equal pieces, to be shared among 5 children, with Anil's plate marked.
images.composition: Two long cakes side by side across the top, a row of five plates below with wide white space, and one question line at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Top: 2 rectangular cakes seen from above, exactly the same size, each cut by 4 straight lines into 5 equal pieces, plain fill with teal #0072B2 outlines. Bottom: 5 empty round plates of the same size, evenly spaced, outlined amber #E69F00; the first plate has a thick reddish purple #CC79A7 outline and its name under it. Caption at the left of each row; question line at the bottom. No pieces on plates, no shading, no candles. Exactly 2 cakes, 10 pieces, 5 plates.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
the fraction 2/5 or any other share written anywhere, or cake pieces placed on plates
images.takeaway: Cut each cake into 5 equal pieces, then share the pieces equally among the 5 plates.
images.description: Two equal cakes each cut into 5 equal pieces above 5 empty plates, the first marked Anil, with the question Anil's share = ? cake.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count all the cake pieces and say how many go on Anil's plate.

image_decisions.why: Cakes already cut into fifths beside 5 plates give the child the sharing method without the answer.
